# New-ZbxUserMacro

## SYNOPSIS

Creates a user macro.

## SYNTAX

```
New-ZbxUserMacro [[-Macro] <string>] [[-Value] <string>] [-HostId <ulong>] [-Type <ZabbixMacroType>] [-Description <string>] [-Config <ZabbixUserMacroConfigRequest>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-InputObject <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

A user macro is a named value, such as {$APP.PORT}, that items, triggers and other fields refer to; a host or template macro overrides a global one. The New-ZbxUserMacro cmdlet sends usermacro.create with one request field per parameter, then reads the new user macro back with usermacro.get and writes it. The server requires -Macro and -Value; -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name and wins over a parameter. A host or template piped from Get-ZbxHost or Get-ZbxTemplate binds -HostId, so one command creates a user macro on each. -WhatIf shows what would be created, and the command needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Add a macro to a host

```powershell
$hostId = (Get-ZbxHost -Name 'web-01').HostId
New-ZbxUserMacro -HostId $hostId -Macro '{$APP.NAME}' -Value 'shop' -Description 'Application name' |
    Select-Object HostMacroId, Macro, Value, Description
```

-HostId is the host's (or template's) id. The created macro is read back and written.

### Example 2: Add the same macro to every host of a group, through the pipeline

```powershell
Get-ZbxHost -Group 'Linux servers' | New-ZbxUserMacro -Macro '{$APP.TIMEOUT}' -Value '30s' |
    Select-Object HostId, Macro, Value
```

A piped host binds -HostId by its HostId property.

### Example 3: Store a secret in a macro

```powershell
$hostId = (Get-ZbxHost -Name 'db-01').HostId
New-ZbxUserMacro -HostId $hostId -Macro '{$DB.PASSWORD}' -Value 'S3cret!' -Type Secret |
    Select-Object Macro, Type, Value
```

-Type Secret stores the value write-only: the API never returns it, so Value reads back empty.

### Example 4: Add a macro to a template

```powershell
Get-ZbxTemplate -Name 'Web App' | New-ZbxUserMacro -Macro '{$APP.PORT}' -Value '80' |
    Select-Object HostId, Macro, Value
```

A piped template binds -HostId through its TemplateId; hosts linked to the template inherit the macro.

## INPUTS

- `ulong`: Bound to -HostId (ByPropertyName).
- `string`: Bound to -Macro (ByPropertyName), -Value (ByPropertyName), -Description (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `ZabbixMacroType`: Bound to -Type (ByPropertyName). The macro type values: ZBX_MACRO_TYPE_* in defines.inc.php.
- `ZabbixUserMacroConfigRequest`: Bound to -Config (ByPropertyName). config of a ZabbixUserMacroCreateRequest.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixUserMacro`: The user macro read model, as returned by the Zabbix API.
